people.name: Herod
people.line: The Great, Roman-appointed king of Judea during Jesus' birth.

translations.web: “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.
translations.bsb: he said, “I will hear your case when your accusers arrive.” Then he ordered that Paul be kept under guard in Herod’s Praetorium.
translations.kjv: I will hear thee, said he, when thine accusers are also come. And he commanded him to be kept in Herod's judgment hall.
translations.asv: I will hear thee fully, said he, when thine accusers also are come: and he commanded him to be kept in Herod's palace.
